name: Hallmark
summary: Design skill for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex that builds UI from 21 themes and 57 anti-slop checks.
description: A SKILL.md rule-set that picks a macrostructure and one of twenty-one themes for each brief, runs fifty-seven slop-test gates plus a pre-emit self-critique, and avoids default LLM output. Four commands: build, audit, redesign and study. Installs into Claude Code, Cursor and Codex by copying files.

worked examples in docs/recipes.md and docs/study-examples.md
